opennyai_summary.final__decision:
For the reasons mentioned in the accompanying affidavit filed in support of this application, delay of 203 days in filing the present Criminal Appeal is hereby condoned.
As the petitioner/appellant/A.4 was convicted under Sections 120-B read with Sections 397, 302 read with Section 34 and under Section 120-B read with 376(A) IPC read with Section 4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 read with Section 34 IPC and sentenced to undergo Imprisonment for "LIFE" which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of natural life apart from other sentences, this Court is not inclined to enlarge Contd., the petitioner /appellant /Accused on bail at this stage.
Accordingly, this application is dismissed.
